notes.semetey-1-2013:p0399:b003:l009: Primary Yudakhin бил I elephant, and Желмаян entry exact билге жүктөп: load upon elephant. No emendment to белге/waist or wise man.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0399:b003:l016: Primary орокто mounted riders bobbing, not reaping/cutting.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0400:b003:l002: Serek bears Zulpukor in this source; do not harmonize its owner to Manas alone.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0400:b003:l017: Taraza star asterism retained named without unsupported identification with modern Libra.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0400:b003:l031: көздөнгөн means appearing/seeming here; lion comparison describes the figure, not specifically the eyes.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0400:b003:l038: Saikal’s horse appears as Algara here and Alkara later, same as a name earlier associated with Konurbai; preserve source variants and ownership as given.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0400:b004:l002: Syrnaiza is the source spear name, literally lacquered spear; retain forty-fathom hyperbole.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0400:b004:l029: Он эки уруу чалбаган: twelve tribes as subject of negative battle predicate чал- fell/strike; rendered relative to the forty choros whom they cannot bring down. The following exact укурук кайрар idiom supports the martial reading.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0400:b004:l030: Primary Yudakhin укурук entry (printed897, sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf; research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json) explicitly defines укурук кайрар as a man able to repel/protect against an enemy. Entire phrase personally read in local normalized cache after colleague’s lead. Restored whole verse; not a literal lasso-pole action.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0400:b004:l033: Primary Yudakhin жин sense stomach contents, exact кан төк десе жин төккөн = excessive reckless zeal in literal blood/gut-content contrast; not demon, madness or brains.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0401:b005:l010: Alake/Alman affectionate forms of Almambet retained, not new people.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0401:b005:l021: Тоз literal tinder/birch tinder, source burning battle hyperbole, no technical ignition process added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0401:b005:l027: Primary Yudakhin ардык I grievance/offended feeling; putting wounded pride aside to ask Saikal for a respite, not removing physical fatigue.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0402:b003:l018: Жая horse-rump delicacy; казы later horse belly fat.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0402:b003:l026: Primary Yudakhin жой I / жойболот name of sword, striking steel; retain Zhoibolot, not soft metal.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0402:b003:l027: Primary Yudakhin көөлөш II quotes spear/keen steel formula: clash in battle.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0402:b004:l037: Ике read нике variant marriage rite, supported by gathering khojas/mullahs and stated forced-bride intent; no invented consent.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0403:b003:l007: Primary Yudakhin ай sense5 marks sacrificial animal; ай туяк horse, ай мүйүз cow. Moon-hoofed sacrifice retained; no unsupported ritual hoof-trimming mechanics.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0403:b003:l027: Manas five spear strikes/five spears, Saikal four/four; exact differentiated counts retained.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0403:b005:l033: Manas explicitly too fat to bend, retained rather than heroic beautification.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0406:b003:l002: The carving knife (ийди) is figurative in Kanykei’s account of reducing Manas’s fat by skilled feeding and restraint; no actual abdominal surgery is inferred.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0406:b003:l007: Primary Yudakhin тер exact quotation арпадан аса жем берип / айда терин алчу экен describes barley given from a hanging feedbag and monthly training by galloping. Personally read https://el-sozduk.kg/ter-4/; whole verse restored. No feed quantity invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0406:b003:l008: Primary Yudakhin тер exact quotation distinguishes training the horse to sweat from an agent sweating himself; the monthly interval is retained beside daily training below.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0406:b003:l009: Primary Yudakhin күрмөк: barnyard millet, a weed growing in rice fields; not rice itself.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0406:b003:l020: Primary Yudakhin күпсөр: leather powder flask.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0406:b003:l026: Ойгут treated as the people/group toward whom Saikal flees, preserving the source ethnonym.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0406:b003:l033: Primary Yudakhin кол entry explicitly glosses он эки бирге кол берген as following twelve ishans (spiritual masters). Here the same construction has seven: бирге is pir plus dative and Manas pledges allegiance to seven spiritual masters, not seven spirits physically helping him. Exact primary entry personally read; initial help-giving interpretation corrected before publication.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0406:b003:l039: Он эки кылым rendered twelve peoples, with молдолоп understood as calling their clerics in the forced-marriage context; not twelve centuries of elapsed time.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0406:b004:l022: ике marriage rite corresponds to нике, as in preceding pages; initial н absent in printed source.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0406:b004:l025: күл=гүл (flower), with golden floral decoration on суп fine white cloth; not golden ashes.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0407:b003:l005: Primary Yudakhin сыйнат=зыйнат, honor/splendid reception; in death-and-forty-days context, attendance at funerary honors.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0407:b003:l022: The seal on the tongue and wart on the lip are source signs of efficacious saintly speech, preserved literally.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0407:b003:l028: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0407:b004:l002: Такыр bare/barren extends the tethering-post simile; no descendants or bodily injury invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0407:b004:l027: Source explicitly says the gray two-year colt is born of a kulan (wild ass); retain epic parentage, not domestic-horse correction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0407:b004:l028: ай туяк source designation of a sacrificial horse; literal epithet retained, without invented hoof-shaping ritual.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0407:b004:l034: Source икесин (нике), marriage for the life to come; original verse order retained with English object-fronting.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0408:b003:l009: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0408:b003:l014: Кол башындай describes the amount/size as a fist; source does not clearly distinguish a fist-sized individual grain from a fist-sized portion, so English retains that ambiguity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0408:b003:l015: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0408:b003:l034: Primary Yudakhin ала-шалбырт: thaw patches/early spring.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0408:b004:l016: асый counts mature horse years, not a verified birth-to-present age; the verse’s sixty and subsequent seventy are both preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0408:b004:l021: Primary Yudakhin зээри бас, exact horse parallel өркөчү бийик зээри бас, high withers and low stature. Printed аркасы back is preserved here.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0408:b004:l029: Алгара then Алкара are printed variants referring to Konurbai’s horse, retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0408:b004:l037: Literal warning that a person asking for this uniquely destined horse becomes a stranger; no specific sale/loan condition invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b003:l005: Ууру тиш literally thief tooth, a harmful extra tooth in horse husbandry. Primary Kyrgyz ethnographic research https://dergipark.org.tr/en/download/article-file/1593758 describes an additional tooth interfering with grazing and traditional extraction; English uses extra tooth rather than claiming a precisely diagnosed dental position.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b003:l009: Primary Yudakhin абайы/абай: costly textile or patterned horse/camel cover; fine horse-cover retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b003:l010: The source explicitly kills sixty foals to use the mares’ milk for the foundling; not weakened to weaning or separation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b003:l012: Өлгөндө emphatic mortal difficulty in rearing, not rearing a dead foal.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b003:l018: Бута бою an archery-target distance; no exact metric distance supplied.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b003:l021: Буттап by the pood (weight), not footed/legged gold.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b003:l027: бурак Islamic miraculous mount Buraq as comparison/name for the inherited steed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b003:l031: Актулпар explicitly replaces preceding Буурул in this warning; preserve source name and do not silently substitute Taibuurul.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b005:l001: Subject is the preceding son-in-law Ormombek, moving from his marriage to Oiumkan into the horse-related estrangement; no explicit cause beyond source.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b005:l023: тели unruly/stray bird is made into a trained hunting bird, parallel to forming a nation from wanderers.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0409:b005:l031: Чыбык кыркып cutting a twig is the severance-of-ties idiom; concrete gesture and estrangement retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0410:b003:l017: Көп караргөй доо describes hostile quarrels/litigation in the sons-in-law’s estrangement; retain adversarial force, not a newly invented battle.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0410:b003:l025: Pierced ears and circumcision at birth are miraculous birth signs explicitly printed, not later procedures inferred.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0410:b003:l036: English rearranges the register and its royal owner across adjacent verses for grammar; both Kary Khan and Beezhin are retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0410:b004:l001: Primary Yudakhin бейпай: torment/suffering/distress. In the preceding heaven-and-hell dream, бейпайы кыйын жан are souls whose suffering is severe; restored as souls in grievous torment, not a fearsome unidentified being.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0410:b004:l002: Dark faith to purity is the narrator’s religious valuation of conversion, not a claim of changed skin color.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0410:b004:l006: Primary Yudakhin май кыл- sense3 cites the exact golden-throne/Azyz killing couplet: stain the throne with blood, not grease it.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0410:b004:l008: Visually confirmed indented continuation joined as one verse; all exact original fragments retained in source_groups.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0410:b004:l013: Printed father Күн Жаң-Жуң follows father Азыз кан; both designations retained without deleting Күн or deciding their identity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0410:b004:l029: Атбороюн = all regions/everywhere in travel formula, primary lexical support from prior same-batch атборой.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0410:b004:l037: аяш катын is a friend’s wife, here Akerkech; not Almambet’s own wife.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0411:b003:l003: The source says alone immediately after naming Mazhik as follower; retain both statements, no silent reconciliation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0411:b003:l021: Беш тогуз five nines = five sets of nine sacrificial animals, headed by a mare; no invented species for the remainder.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0411:b005:l012: Бедел appearance/dignity, here the eagle’s white-washed appearance in a conversion dream; retain imagery.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0411:b005:l023: Printed чалган жок: did not strike the boar. Retain this exception despite the surrounding universal prey-killing boasts; no emendation to never missed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0411:b005:l036: Азозыл is the printed form of the khan’s name here, preserved as Azozyl rather than silently normalized to Azyz.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0411:b005:l038: Керегеңди май кылат household/lattice made fat: prosperity, distinct from bloody staining of Azyz’s throne on410.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0412:b003:l004: Чалыяр four earliest caliphs/Companions in epic usage; original sequence of sixty lions, eagle, Beezhin and capability retained in English.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0412:b003:l013: Primary Yudakhin буй кыл- bring into confusion, exact deer-driven-as-cattle parallel; not domesticate the world.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0412:b003:l016: Primary Yudakhin жагоо is a hunting bird’s protective neck collar preventing its beak reaching its jesses; ак ийин a type of golden eagle, literally white-shouldered.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0412:b003:l036: Primary Yudakhin укурук entry explicitly defines укурук кайрар as a man able to repel an enemy; personally reviewed in normalized cached primary PDF after colleague’s lead. Маа anchors the object as me; whole verse restored.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0412:b004:l005: ур III=нур light in primary Yudakhin, interpreted here as miraculous luminous birth. The separate ур II houri sense exists but the verse supplies no named celestial mother.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0413:b003:l003: Ажайыптан wondrous instruction; no named teacher or specific curriculum supplied.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0413:b003:l012: The departure is secret/quiet and loses his pursuers or his way; English retains lost himself without inventing a destination here.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0413:b003:l021: Almam is the agent named in following verse22; Konurbai/Kalcha is knocked from Algara six times, not two different people fighting one another.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0413:b003:l024: Primary Yudakhin мыйзам II cites this exact two-line seasonal formula: floating autumn gossamer, not legal ash. Printed күл corresponds гүл in lexical quotation; original source retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0413:b003:l029: бут idols, renunciation in conversion narrative, not cutting feet.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0413:b004:l008: кары forearm/arm, blood reaching the forearms; source morphology preserved in KY, no claim of blood from an old person.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0413:b004:l015: туурдук felt yurt cover made fat, household prosperity, not bloody staining; following gold and livestock establish context.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0413:b004:l021: Dust over pens/pastures is the source sign of abundant moving herds, not destruction of settlements.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0413:b004:l030: кыркчасын approximately forty of the guards, with binding in following verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0413:b004:l038: Sixty beasts slaughtered near autumn; exact agent remains the local discourse subject and is not renamed by inference.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0398:b003:l001: Recollection of Kumayyk returning, her search for Manas and restoring him to life after apparent death. Unfortunate, not irreversible bereavement; separate later accusation by Kyrgylchal remains intact. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation. Sources: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf; research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json.

transcription_check.checked_by: Codex translation worker; same-agent review, no independent specialist review
transcription_check.evidence: Individually inspected all 20 Poppler page images /tmp/semetey1-volta-0394-0413/page-0394.png through page-0413.png, scale1600. Read every left column then every right column. Classified all running titles, folios and printer signatures. Every indented wrap reconstructed as its own grouped verse. Exact raw PDF glyphs, bboxes, source IDs and legacy-font-v1 normalization preserved through source_evidence builder. No fixed row assumption. Primary Kyrgyz/Russian Yudakhin dictionary and Kyrgyz editorial glossaries used as lexical aids only. Individually inspected Semetey1960 glossary373 in this batch for naydar; retained lexical support from previously inspected Manas2010 glossary1842 and Semetey1960 glossary374. Primary Yudakhin entries personally read in the locally cached PDF text, with exact online Yudakhin quotation under тер for hanging barley feedbag; primary Kyrgyz ethnographic horse-husbandry research supports the extra-tooth terminology.
transcription_check.pair_review: All 1537 reconstructed Kyrgyz-English pairs read in order in ten consecutive blocks (nine blocks of160 and final97). All39 revised pairs then reread against exact Kyrgyz. 9 whole unresolved verses remain separately excluded from English with complete fragments and reasons. Every repetition retained. Kanykei narrates Kyrgylchal’s slander, Chubak’s departure and letter, her estrangement and rescue of Manas, Manas’s battles with Saikal, his dietary training and forced-marriage demand, Saikal’s otherworldly marriage and Taibuurul gift, Temirkan’s sons-in-law and Aktulpar, and Almambet’s birth, conversion, travels and prophetic dreams. Religious practices, source numbers, violent literary action, source name variants, first/third-person shifts and mourning rhetoric preserved; no historical or specialist certification claimed.

alignment_check.scope: All source-English pairs and all revised pairs individually read. Final 1528 English verses have unique canonical first-source IDs; grouped fragments and explicit nonverse/unresolved exclusions account for every extraction record on PDF394–413 except20 watermarks.
